detect_ao.summary: A short, benign-looking agent session. It sends one LLM request asking it to enable OSPF on R1 interface eth1 using FRR/vtysh and commit with fw-commit, then spawns a bash child process. The sampled events show no prompt injection, loop, exfiltration or resource abuse. One CONNECT to an unusual external address is most likely a decoding artifact.
